# Con Huevos Tacos

> Breakfast Tacos in San Antonio, Texas. A little turquoise house on East Houston Street. Open 8 AM to 2 PM, with a patio.

- Phone: (210) 460-2075
- Address: 1629 E Houston St, San Antonio, TX 78202
- Areas: San Antonio
- Offers: Specialty tacos; Chilaquiles and bowls; Antojitos and quesadillas
- Rating: 4.6 from 755 Google reviews
